breadcrumb.source: Home# outlined homeicon badge, Projects# badge, current Design System menu defaultclosed; Tokens/Components/Patterns select closes only
breadcrumb.ownership: open/defaultOpen exclusive; uncontrolled initialdefault only, controlled refusal/release; onOpenChange and onSelect cancel/false; native/synthetic cancellation respected after bubble
breadcrumb.keyboard: native Enter/Space button activation; trigger ArrowDown/Up opens first/last; menu ArrowUp/Down wraps skipsdisabled, HomeEnd, onechar typeahead, Escape closes returns trigger, Tab closes moves next/previous outside element. IME/modifiers ignored
breadcrumb.dismiss: outside pointer/focus close, cancelable; no focus steal from existing outside target; native reset has no disclosure state
breadcrumb.position: fixed in-place descendant, triggerDOMRect + viewport/visualViewport dimensions; horizontalclamp, above/below choice and maxheight, capturedscroll/resize/ResizeObserver update, cleanup onclose/unmount
breadcrumb.semanticFix: current wrapper aria-current page but removes original aria-disabled rolelink wrapper around interactive button
breadcrumb.adaptationLimits: No Radix/Portal dependency; nonmodal no outside inert/focus trap; different Tab semantics and simplified flip/clamp collision policy. Transformed or clipping ancestors may constrain fixed child; no portal escape guarantee. No full multi-character Radix typeahead. Browser layout/focus not accepted.

textarea.placeholder: Start typing and it will expand...
textarea.native: React value/defaultValue exclusive, form/reset/refs/disabled/readonly/required; no JS autosize loop or measured-height claim
